description: This file contains the implementation of the Typed.js library, which provides animated typing effects for web pages. It defines a Typed class with methods for initializing, building, typing, backspacing, shuffling, and resetting typed text, along with default options and jQuery plugin integration.

classes.name: Typed
classes.description: A class that manages animated typing effects on HTML elements, supporting options like speed, looping, shuffling, and callbacks.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the typing effect, inserts cursor, and prepares strings for typing.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Starts the typing loop with the first string after a delay.

methods.name: typewrite
methods.description: Types out a string character by character with optional pauses and HTML handling.

methods.name: backspace
methods.description: Removes characters from the current string with optional HTML handling, then proceeds to next string.

methods.name: shuffleArray
methods.description: Randomly shuffles an array of string indices for shuffling string order.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the typing effect, removing current content and reinitializing.
